docs.title: About
docs.text: typingman is a team of developers, designers, and writers from Aachen, Germany. We are passionate about creating software that is easy to use and fun to work with. This is our website where we share our projects, documentation, blog posts, and thoughts. So, feel free to explore and get in touch with us.

docs.title: Where to find us
docs.text: Follow us on GitHub. If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to contact us at hey@typingman.com.

docs.title: Projects
docs.text: Take a look at our latest projects and see what we are working on.

docs.title: JobKick
docs.text: A job board for developers to kick-start your career.

docs.title: We are launching JobKick!
docs.text: We are excited to announce the launch of JobKick, a job board for developers. We are currently in beta and will be launching soon. Stay tuned for more updates!
